description: Miter angles three ways: corner mode (any corner angle between two pieces), sides mode (regular polygon with N sides), crown mode (miter + bevel for crown molding at a spring angle).

corner_angle_deg.description: corner mode: interior corner angle, e.g. 90 or 135

sides.description: sides mode: number of sides of the frame/polygon

spring_angle_deg.description: crown mode: spring angle, typically 38 or 45

name: miter_angle_calculator
